notes:
Account summary: Horizon Financial Insights is evaluating Dedicated capacity for latency-sensitive client-facing assistants and a real-time reranking layer for downstream trading analytics. They are conservative on cost but will pay for strong latency guarantees and predictable unit economics.

Recent timeline (high level):
- 2026-01-15: Intro discovery call (Maya) — scope: chat assistant (SLAs), reranker. Client emphasized compliance/regulatory constraints.
- 2026-01-28: Security sync w/ DPO. Provided SOC2 artifacts; DPO requested on-prem option and KMS integration.
- 2026-02-10: Technical kickoff (ff-2026-02-10-1130). SE demo of Dedicated routing and autoscaling. Agreed to POC plan.
- 2026-02-18: Sent POC plan + representative prompt set (drive:/Shared/Redwood/horizon-dedicated-poc-plan.pdf).
- 2026-03-05: Load-test check-in (ff-2026-03-05-0930). Ran first sustained load against 4x A100 config. Observed intermittent p95 spikes ~650ms during KV cache warm-up.
- 2026-03-11: Soak test started (12h window). Client running synthetic traffic and replay of production traces.

POC goals and acceptance criteria (customer-facing):
- Throughput: sustain 120 reqs/s for short sequences (avg 64 tokens) without queueing beyond 2s.
- Latency SLOs: target p50 < 80ms, p95 < 350ms for typical chat requests (256-512 tokens generation); require documented tail behavior for bursts.
- Soak: 24h continuous with <0.5% error rate and no memory leaks / KV cache corruption.
- Failover: automated fallback to smaller model with graceful degradation tested during load spikes.
- Residency/security: deployment must live in customer VPC with HSM/KMS keywrap and audit logging forwarded to their SIEM.

Representative prompts used in POC (samples):
- "Summarize quarterly risk exposures across our derivatives book (500 tokens). Include confidence bands and critical flags"
- "Rerank these 25 alert candidates by likelihood of false-positive using past label history and metadata."
- "Extract named entities and PII redaction candidates from client-communication transcripts (variable length up to 8k tokens)."
- "Assist agent: provide concise next-action suggestion based on account history and regulatory constraints."

Performance observations so far (from SE notes):
- Warm cache helps: p95 drops ~180ms after prefix caching for repeated session traffic.
- Batching strategy: continuous batching improved throughput but increased p95 for single-shot low-latency calls; need per-route policies.
- GPU sizing: 4x A100 provided expected throughput for embeddings and medium chat loads; client is pushing to 8x H100 for headroom and lower p95 during burst windows.
- Quantization and model variants: recommended using 4-bit quantized variant for non-critical reranking to save cost; keep FP16 for main chat assistant.

Security/compliance notes:
- DPO requires full audit-log capture and 90-day retention for debug traces; wants option to redact tokens before long-term storage.
- KMS integration tested in staging; minor key rotation automation step required.
- Legal: needs attestation that no customer data will be retained in shared caches beyond configured TTL.

Commercial / SLA negotiation points:
- Customer wants explicit p95 latency SLA for chat route; proposing tiered credits (partial credits for p95 > target, full credits for sustained outage).
- Reserved capacity pricing: customer prefers committed monthly GPU pool with burst credits for seasonal spikes. Need to confirm burst unit pricing and overage cap.

Next steps (short):
- Finish 24h soak (SE: Daniel) and collect metrics deck (ETA 2026-03-13).
- Run managed failover test and quantized model comparison (two runs) 2026-03-14.
- DPO review: deliver KMS rotation doc and audit-log sample by 2026-03-16.
- Procurement to confirm budget window; AE to send preliminary T&Cs for Dedicated.

Customer quotes / color: "Latency tail is make-or-break for our external advisor UI — 95th percentile spikes cost us conversions. We'll trade cost for predictability."

Misc: Jira tickets INF-7891 for load-test anomaly (SE investigating), INF-8023 for KMS rotation automation request. Gmail thread ids for legal/commercial are in linked_gmail_threads. Drive contains the POC plan and initial benchmark deck.

Short notes to AE/SE: keep soak metrics granular (per-route p50/p95/p99), include token-level cost breakdown, and propose two SKU recommendations (steady reserved + burst credits).
